_doc: BBB-tier covenant + operating metrics — chunk B (9 obligors incl. distressed)
_methodology: WebSearch + WebFetch on rating agency press releases, Bond Buyer, Becker's, EMMA, CHFFA staff reports, and audited financial statements. Where MTI covenant terms are not publicly disclosed verbatim, we use industry-typical defaults (DCOH min 65, DSCR min 1.10x) and flag _warning. Distressed obligors (Tower, ProMedica, Cabell Huntington, UC Health) are flagged with confirmed covenant breach history.

Lompoc Valley Medical Center._notes: Stable Baa1 healthcare district. 2018 DCOH 121 vs 30-day floor → massive headroom. DSCR 7.4 vs 1.25 floor. Unique among chunk: stricter 1.25x DSCR covenant (vs industry 1.10x) but lower 30-day DCOH floor.

Mount Sinai Health System (NYC)._notes: Split-rated; recent August 2024 Moody's downgrade Baa1 → Baa3 = TIGHTENING. Operating losses + DCOH compression. Recovering in 2025 but still volatile. Use Baa3 (Moody's) not single-A (Fitch/S&P) — Moody's is honest read.

key_findings: Tower Health DSCR BREACH confirmed as of 12/31/2024 per EMMA forbearance agreement
Cabell Huntington MTI DSCR 1.10x consultant trigger / 1.0x event of concern (2 consecutive years) — explicit MTI language retrieved
Lompoc Valley has STRICTER DSCR (1.25x) but LOWER DCOH (30 day) — atypical combo for a community district
ProMedica recovering: 8.1% operating margin 2025 after 2022 debt-to-cap covenant violation; sub-IG ratings lag operating reality
UC Health DSCR -2.66 in FY2023, well below 1.10x; recovery underway with Medicaid supplemental payments
AHN: 53 DCOH at 12/31/2024 below typical 65-day floor — covenant proximity if MTI uses standard threshold
Mount Sinai Moody's downgrade Aug 2024 Baa1→Baa3 honest read; S&P/Fitch single-A stale
